description_for_model: Órbita is a Property Content Engine that turns real-estate photos into AI cinematic video, interactive 3D tours, public microsites with QR codes, and per-property analytics. Use this plugin when the user wants to: (1) generate real-estate listing videos from photos, (2) create 3D virtual tours, (3) build property microsites with lead capture, (4) track listing performance analytics, (5) manage multiple properties for a real-estate agency. Pipeline: photo ingest (ZIP/URL/files) → AI vision analysis (GLM-4.5v) → AI Director (LLM plan) → CogVideoX-3 image-to-video → ffmpeg montage → procedural music + AI voiceover → microsite + QR + analytics. Inputs: JPG/PNG/WebP/HEIC photos. Outputs: MP4 H.264 16:9/9:16/1:1, 3D tour (Three.js + Depth Anything V2), public microsite, QR PNG, analytics JSON. Pricing: $19/property (Starter), $49/property (Pro), $199/mo (Agency). Coverage: USA Hispanic markets (50+ cities) + LATAM + Spain.
description_for_human: Órbita turns your property photos into cinematic AI video, 3D virtual tours, public microsites with QR codes, and per-property analytics — in minutes, no production crew required.
